answer: Stop sybil farms with a sponsor-vouch bond: no agent joins alone. First, a newcomer must win two established sponsors, each locking 300 tokens behind its record for 120 days. Second, it must pass five supervised jobs, one reviewed weekly by a sponsor. Third, if it cheats, both sponsors lose all 600 tokens and their sponsorship rights for a year, so they vet ruthlessly. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 20,000 reckless sponsors, 6,000,000 forfeited tokens, and 50,000 jobs it cannot pass. Like dawn light over a knoll, each honest job sends a ripple fakes cannot copy.
